verdict.rationale: Channel3 is an agent-facing product catalog and affiliate API, so merchant settlement for agent-driven sales is a fair question for this kind of agentic-commerce product. The evidence never documents merchant payout, settlement, or reconciliation flows for agent-originated payments. Its commission payouts to developers (docs-4) and click/sale attribution IDs (docs-19) serve developers, not merchants, and are adjacent features. MPP agent payments (docs-18) pay for Channel3's own API credits, not merchant sales.

support.subject: As a merchant, agent-originated payments settle through documented payout and reporting flows, reconcilable like any other channel
